# Getty Images

> > Getty Images is a global visual content platform providing royalty-free stock photos, editorial imagery, videos, vectors, and AI-powered image generation with commercial licensing and legal protection.

Getty Images operates multiple brands including iStock, Unsplash, and VisualGPS, offering access to millions of creative and editorial assets. The platform features exclusive collections from partners like Bloomberg, Sports Illustrated, BBC, NBC, and major sports organizations including FIFA, NBA, MLB, and the International Olympic Committee, alongside Generative AI tools for commercially safe image creation.

## Key Topics

- Royalty-free stock photography
- Editorial content and news imagery
- AI image generation and modification
- Commercial licensing and legal protection
- Sports photography and coverage
- iStock and Unsplash platforms
- VisualGPS insights
- Rights clearance services
- Video licensing
- Creative images and vectors
- Bloomberg Photo Service
- Sports Illustrated archive
- Olympic and FIFA World Cup coverage
- Music photography (Redferns)
- API integration

## Core Platform & Services

- [Royalty-Free Stock Photos, Creative Images & Vectors | News, Fashion, and Entertainment imagery - Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com): Getty Images homepage: stock photos, vectors, editorial & video content
- [About Us | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/about-us): Company overview of Getty Images, iStock, Unsplash & VisualGPS platform
- [Getty Images API | Image API, Video API, Vector API | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/api): Getty Images API for integrating images, videos & illustrations via OAuth

## AI-Powered Image Generation

- [Commercially safe AI Image Generation and Modification | Generative AI by Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai): Generative AI product for commercially safe AI image creation & editing
- [AI Image Generator | High-Quality Text to Image AI Generation](https://www.gettyimages.com/ai/generation): Text-to-image AI generator with legal protection & commercial licensing

## Premium Editorial Collections

- [Global news and sports coverage | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/collections/media-and-sports): Global sports & news partnerships: F1, FIFA, NBA, MLB archival content
- [2026 Winter Olympic Games, 2026 Paralympics Games - Photos & Videos | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/collections/olympics): Milano Cortina 2026 Olympics & Paralympics photography & video coverage
- [Bloomberg - Tell your story with images and video from our Bloomberg collection. | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/collections/bloomberg): Bloomberg Photo Service collection: business & financial news imagery
- [Sports Illustrated - Award-Winning Sports Photography | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/collections/sports-illustrated): Sports Illustrated collection: award-winning sports photography archive
- [Motorsports Images - Iconic Racing Moments Captured | Getty Images | Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/collections/motorsports): Motorsport Images: 26M+ racing photos from F1, MotoGP, Formula E & more
